resume.name: Sham Mathur

experience.reason: Company relocating its finance operations to Bengaluru.
Moved to an in-house finance role.

achievements: Cut Sahyadri's month-end close from 9 days to 4.
Recovered ₹31 lakh in duplicate vendor payments during a 2019 audit.
resume.statement: I am a careful, unhurried accountant. I would rather close the books a day late than close them wrong.
resume.footer: Resume prepared and submitted by CareerNest Placements, Pune (ref. CN-56-2214).

age.note: The ID card's date of birth makes him 40. The resume says 56. Sixteen years is not a rounding error.

aadhaar.dob.note: Date of birth on the ID card matches the resume exactly.

employment.left.note: The relieving letter confirms he left Sahyadri in September 2026.

c01_agency.text: The resume was formatted and submitted by a placement agency (CareerNest), not by the candidate himself.

c01_experience_span.text: 17 years of experience starting in 2009: a career timeline that fits a man in his late 30s, not 56.

c01_relieved.text: Immediate availability: Sahyadri is relocating its finance team out of Pune.

c01_age_mismatch.text: CONTRADICTION: claimed age 56, but the DOB on his ID (29-08-1986) makes him 40.

c01_relieving_ok.text: Relieving letter matches the resume: Senior Accounts Officer, 06-2015 to 09-2026.

c01_agency_error.text: CareerNest admits its template overwrote the age field with the file code "56" on several resumes. Corrected copy shows age 40.

c01_sahyadri_confirms.text: Sahyadri HR confirms his role and dates and calls him "the most reliable person in finance". He is leaving only because the team is relocating.

c01_bhave_praise.text: His first employer says he once refused to sign off a client's inflated invoices, at the cost of the firm's biggest account.

c01_bhave_slow.text: Former partner notes he was "slow, painfully thorough" and missed two filing deadlines in his first year.

c01_fraud_news.text: A news archive headline: "Sham Mathur, 56, held in cooperative bank fraud".

c01_fraud_other.text: Follow-up report: the accused is Shamrao K. Mathur, 56, of Nagpur. A different person.

c01_cma_verified.text: Institute portal: CMA Intermediate pass for Sham Mathur (2012) is verified.

search.title: Sham Mathur, 56, held in cooperative bank fraud
search.snippet: Police arrested a 56-year-old accountant over ₹2.3 crore missing from a cooperative bank...
search.body: NAGPUR, March 2025. Police have arrested a 56-year-old accountant identified as Sham Mathur in connection with ₹2.3 crore missing from the Wardha Road Cooperative Bank. The accused had worked at the bank for eleven years. Further details are awaited.

search.title: Correction: name of accused in bank fraud case
search.snippet: An earlier report misidentified the accused. The accused is Shamrao K. Mathur of Nagpur...
search.body: CORRECTION. Our report of 9 March misidentified the accused in the Wardha Road Cooperative Bank case. The accused is Shamrao K. Mathur, 56, a resident of Nagpur. We regret the error.

search.title: Sahyadri Agro moves finance ops to Bengaluru
search.snippet: The exporter will shift its accounts and treasury teams by October 2026...
search.body: Sahyadri Agro Exports will move its accounts and treasury teams to Bengaluru by October 2026. Employees who could not relocate have been relieved with full benefits.
